lines_zh: 梅尔丹，维里迪亚 · 3724 年雾月 10 日

lines: Febric ｜ → ｜ Hreda and I are both safely inside the Greater Plum Harbor. We will survive the best that we can.
Hreda ｜ → ｜ Northglade was invaded this morning. ｜ 20045
Hreda ｜ → ｜ It looked like there were barely any battles, as though our politicians and army are totally okay with this happening. ｜ 20060
Hreda ｜ → ｜ Febric and I are safely inside the Greater Plum Harbor. The Arctics seem to be respecting it as some kind of neutral zone, at least for now. ｜ 20071
Hreda ｜ → ｜ I'm scared. I hope everything will be okay.
